lines.en: I tap on Imani’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer, hoping that her constant, overly-friendly banter with me isn’t just her brand of fucking around.
lines.zh: 我点开手机里 Imani 的名字,等她接起——心里盼着,她和我那些没完没了、过分亲昵的斗嘴,并不只是她特有的胡闹方式。

lines.en: We’ve hung out after work several times before, but never without the company of someone else. So I guess tonight is the night I find out if she’s cool with that or not.
lines.zh: 下班后我们聚过几次,但从来没有过只我们两个人。所以大概今晚,就是验证她介不介意的日子。

lines.en: If not, I’ll just...find something else to do instead.
lines.zh: 如果介意,我就……找点别的事做。

lines.en: But if she is, I can finally begin the process of figuring out how to sleep with her.
lines.zh: 但如果不介意,我终于可以开始研究怎么和她上床了。

lines.en: Watch out, Imani. I’m coming for you.
lines.zh: 小心了,Imani。我冲你来了。

lines.en: : Yo, Senpai! What’s goin’ on?
lines.zh: : 哟,Senpai!什么事?

lines.en: : Hey. What are you doing tonight?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你今晚有安排吗?

lines.en: : Well, right now, I’m busy grading papers for the work I assigned to everyone while you were sleeping in your office the other day.
lines.zh: : 嗯,眼下我正忙着改作业呢——就是你那天在办公室睡觉时给大家布置的那份。

lines.en: : What kind of work are you giving our students behind my back?
lines.zh: : 你背着我给学生布置的什么作业?

lines.en: : I just told them to write two pages about shit they think is cool.
lines.zh: : 我就是让他们写两页,关于他们觉得很酷的东西。

lines.en: : Did you know both Ami and Ayane wrote about you? I’m worried they may have copied each other’s work.
lines.zh: : 你知道 Ami 和 Ayane 都写的是你吗?我担心她们可能互相抄了。

lines.en: : Stop doing that and hang out with me instead.
lines.zh: : 别改了,来陪我。

lines.en: : Just you?
lines.zh: : 只有我?

lines.en: : Is this a booty call?
lines.zh: : 这是约炮电话吗?

lines.en: : ...Could it be?
lines.zh: : ……会不会是?

lines.en: : Mmm...we probably shouldn’t. I like whatever we have going on right now.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我们大概不该。我喜欢我们现在这样。

lines.en: : Best to keep stuff professional in the least professional way possible, you know?
lines.zh: : 最好用以最不专业的方式,保持专业,你知道吧?

lines.en: : Plus, I don’t want you holding my job hostage in exchange for being at the beck and call of your endless libido.
lines.zh: : 再说,我不想让你拿我的工作当人质,来满足你那无边无际的性欲。

lines.en: : It’s not endless. I have a recharge period.
lines.zh: : 它并非无际。我有充能期。

lines.en: : Well, don’t count on me to drain that battery of yours.
lines.zh: : 那就别指望我来帮你放电。

lines.en: : If you do want to come over and get comfortable, though, I’d probably open the door for you.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是真想过来放松放松,我大概会给你开门。

lines.en: : I’m getting mixed signals here. People don’t normally invite me over unless they want to have sex with me.
lines.zh: : 我接收到的信号很混乱。一般人请我过去,都是想和我上床的。

lines.en: : Or...need help making soup.
lines.zh: : 或者……需要人帮忙做汤。

lines.en: : I like soup.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢汤。

lines.en: : Just send me your address, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那就把地址发我吧,我猜。

lines.en: : Right-o. Comin’ at you, brother.
lines.zh: : 好嘞。马上到,兄弟。

lines.en: : Don’t call me that.
lines.zh: : 别那么叫我。

lines.en: : Nii-chan?
lines.zh: : Nii-chan?

lines.en: : Slightly better.
lines.zh: : 稍微好一点。

lines.en: : Daddy?
lines.zh: : Daddy?

lines.en: : Again with the mixed signals.
lines.zh: : 你又来混乱信号这一套了。

lines.en: : Don’t keep me waiting, Senpai-Niichan-Daddy. It’s sooooo lonely over here.
lines.zh: : 别让我等太久,Senpai-Niichan-Daddy。这边好————孤单。

lines.en: I hang up the phone before I fall victim to the never-ending games of my student teacher and patiently await her address so I can be led on some more.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话——免得沦为我的实习老师那无穷无尽游戏的受害者——然后耐心等她的地址,好让自己再被牵着走一程。

lines.en: I half expect it to be similar to Wakana’s or Kaori’s address based on how regular convenient coincidences have become in my life, but am sorely disappointed when I see that it’s not.
lines.zh: 半凭直觉,我以为那地址会与 Wakana 或 Kaori 的一致——毕竟「恰到好处的巧合」在我的人生里已成日常——结果大失所望。

lines.en: In fact, it’s an address I don’t recognize at all. And after plugging it into my phone, I realize it’s on the outskirts of the old district, not far from the bar we went to the other day.
lines.zh: 实际上,那是个我完全不认识的地址。输入手机一查,才发现它在旧城区边缘,离我们前几天去的酒吧不远。

lines.en: That’s...good for her, I guess. She can kill time getting drunk and stumbling home while I am forced to kill time by walking all over town.
lines.zh: 那……对她来说算好事吧,我猜。她可以喝到烂醉、摇摇晃晃地回家消磨时间,而我却只能靠走遍全城来消磨时间。

lines.en: And occasionally fucking a teenager or two.
lines.zh: 偶尔再上一两个未成年人。

lines.en: But unless Imani is keeping one as a prisoner, I can’t imagine anything like that is going to happen tonight...
lines.zh: 但除非 Imani 私下囚禁了什么人,我想今晚不会发生那种事……

lines.en: : Yo! Is that you, Senpai? Or is that an assassin sent by the government to eliminate me?
lines.zh: : 哟!是你吗,Senpai?还是政府派来除掉我的刺客?

lines.en: : Both.
lines.zh: : 两者都是。

lines.en: : Shit, what a twist.
lines.zh: : 靠,好一个反转。

lines.en: : Come on in. Door’s unlocked.
lines.zh: : 进来吧。门没锁。

lines.en: I make my way into Imani’s apartment, which feels more like a large closet than an actual living space.
lines.zh: 我走进 Imani 的公寓——与其说这是个生活空间,不如说更像一个大壁橱。

lines.en: It’s situated in a two story building with about twenty other rooms and is clearly meant to be some sort of affordable housing unit.
lines.zh: 它坐落在一栋两层小楼里,与另外约二十个房间为邻,显然本就是某种保障性住房。

lines.en: But I guess it’s better to have something like this than it is to be sleeping on the streets or...in the changing room of a spa.
lines.zh: 不过我猜,有这样的地方住,总好过睡大街,或者……睡在桑拿房的更衣室里。

lines.en: : Heya. Congrats on being my first ever visitor. I’d say we should christen the place, but I’m afraid I’d find out I’m a 6/10 lay as well.
lines.zh: : 嗨。恭喜你成为我的第一位访客。我本想说我们该给这地方「开光」,但恐怕我会发现自己做爱也只是个 6/10 的水平。

lines.en: : You’re still not over that?
lines.zh: : 你还没走出来呢?

lines.en: : How would you feel if somebody gave you a 6/10 when it comes to kissing?
lines.zh: : 要是有人给你的接吻打了个 6/10,你会作何感受?

lines.en: : I think I’d be more curious about their prior experience and grading scale than whatever my score is.
lines.zh: : 我觉得比起我的分数,我会更好奇他们此前的经验和评分标准。

lines.en: : Fair enough. Pull up a seat, I guess. Not like there are many of them in here, though.
lines.zh: : 有道理。随便坐吧,我猜。虽然这屋里也没几把椅子。

lines.en: : I think my bedroom is larger than your apartment.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我的卧室都比你的公寓大。

lines.en: : Did you come here to brag?
lines.zh: : 你是来炫耀的?

lines.en: : No. But I’m pretty sure that it’s something that’s going to just naturally happen at several points tonight.
lines.zh: : 不是。但我很确定,今晚会有好几个时刻,这话会自然而然地冒出来。

lines.en: : I know it’s small, but I don’t mind. All that really matters is just having a place to sleep and work and, as you can see, both of those things are entirely possible within these walls.
lines.zh: : 我知道它小,但我不介意。真正要紧的不过是有个能睡觉、能工作的地方——如你所见,这两件事在这四面墙之内都完全可行。

lines.en: : Where’s your cat?
lines.zh: : 你的猫呢?

lines.en: : Cat?
: And your parrot?
lines.zh: : 那你的鹦鹉呢?

lines.en: : Parrot?
lines.zh: : 鹦鹉?

lines.en: : Didn’t you-
lines.zh: : 你不是说——

lines.en: : Did I mention having either of those things?
lines.zh: : 我提过我有其中任何一样吗?

lines.en: : Unless I’m going insane, I’m pretty sure you did.
lines.zh: : 除非我疯了,我很确定你说过。

lines.en: : I was probably just fucking with you. I don’t have any pets.
lines.zh: : 我多半只是在耍你。我什么宠物都没有。

lines.en: : Well, except for the cockroach who keeps trying to get into bed with me at night. But I think he’s just got the wrong idea about the two of us.
lines.zh: : 嗯,除了那只一到晚上就想爬上我床的蟑螂。不过我觉得,它对我们俩的关系有什么误解。

lines.en: : Why would you lie about owning a cat? Who does that?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要谎称养了猫?谁会干这种事?

lines.en: : Me, I guess. I probably thought it was funny. Just do yourself a favor and never believe anything I say unless it makes me look cooler.
lines.zh: : 我吧,我猜。我大概以为那样很搞笑。帮你自己一个忙吧——除非让我显得更酷,否则别信我说的任何话。

lines.en: : I think a parrot would make you look a little cooler.
lines.zh: : 我觉得养只鹦鹉能让你酷一点点。

lines.en: : Hey, if I start saving up for one now, I might finally be able to afford one by the time I retire.
lines.zh: : 嘿,要是我从现在开始存钱,说不定到退休那天就能买得起一只了。

lines.en: : It’ll be before that. Just think of how much money you’re saving by living here.
lines.zh: : 会更早的。想想你住在这里省下了多少钱。

lines.en: : Lay off the slander and sit down. It’s starting to feel like you’re only here to observe me and not to actually chill.
lines.zh: : 别诽谤了,坐下吧。这开始让我觉得,你只是来观察我的,不是来玩的。

lines.en: : You’re not going to make me help you grade things, are you? Because Wakana has tried to do that before and I still get a little nervous every time I go to see her now.
lines.zh: : 你不会要让我帮你改作业吧?Wakana 试过一次,现在每次去见她我都还有点紧张。

lines.en: : Sure you’re not getting nervous because you want to bang her?
lines.zh: : 你确定你紧张不是因为想上她?

lines.en: : That’s not really something I’d ever get nervous about.
lines.zh: : 那种事我不会紧张的。

lines.en: : Look at me, my name is Sensei. I’m confident and sexually active. I don’t feel feelings the way “normal” humans do.
lines.zh: : 看看我,我叫 Sensei。我自信、性生活丰富。我感受不到「正常」人类的那种情绪。

lines.en: : Look at me, I’m Imani. I’m a huge fucking bitch.
lines.zh: : 看看我,我是 Imani。我是个天杀的大贱人。

lines.en: : You offend me. I’m a medium-sized bitch at most.
lines.zh: : 你冒犯到我了。我顶多算个中号贱人。

lines.en: : But no, I’m not going to make you help me grade anything because I am awesome and have already finished.
lines.zh: : 不过不,我不会让你帮我改任何东西,因为我太厉害了,已经改完了。

lines.en: : I also know much more about what everyone in the class is actually into now.
lines.zh: : 我也顺便更了解班里每个人真正的兴趣了。

lines.en: : For example, did you know that the role of women in Yasu’s religion is to basically just lie there and let a dude spray his baby batter inside of her?
lines.zh: : 举个例子,你知道吗,在 Yasu 的宗教里,女性的角色基本上就是躺在那里,任由一个男人把他的种子喷进体内?

lines.en: : I did. And, just for the record, these assignments of yours aren’t things that need to be filed away or...scanned in, are they?
lines.zh: : 我知道。顺便郑重声明,你布置的这些作业,不会需要归档,或者……扫描存底,对吧?

lines.en: : Because that and the ones written about me aren’t things I want anyone other than you getting their hands on.
lines.zh: : 因为那个,加上写我的那些,都不是我想让除了你之外的任何人染指的东西。

lines.en: : Aww, are we close enough now that you don’t mind me knowing how creepy you are?
lines.zh: : 哎呀,我们现在够亲密了吗?亲密到你不介意我知道你有多变态?

lines.en: : Like you’ve said before, we make a good team. And I think a lot of that is due to how easy it is for me to talk to you without feeling like I’m being judged.
lines.zh: : 就像你以前说的,我们配合得很好。我想,很大程度上是因为,和你聊天时我不用害怕被评判。

lines.en: : Oh, I judge you all the time. I’ve just also judged everyone else and have somehow, after several loops and twists, reached the conclusion that you're not out to hurt anybody.
lines.zh: : 哦,我时时刻刻都在评判你。只是我也评判了其他人,并在几轮循环与转折之后,不知怎么得出了结论:你没有要伤害任何人的意思。

lines.en: : Except me, that is. I’m pretty sure being mean to me gets you hard. But, in order to keep this professional, I promise to not bring up your penis again for the rest of the night.
lines.zh: : 除了我,当然。我相当确定,对我刻薄能让你硬。不过,为了维持专业,我保证今晚剩下时间不再提你的肉棒。

lines.en: : Thanks, Imani. I understand how difficult that must be for you since I figured you're almost always fantasizing about it.
lines.zh: : 谢了,Imani。我知道这对你有多难,毕竟我猜你几乎无时不刻不在幻想它。

lines.en: : Not always. Just whenever you leave the room. Gotta keep my guard up when you’re around, you know? Don’t wanna get pregnant and feel the wrathful gazes of nineteen jealous teens.
lines.zh: : 不是无时无刻。只是你每次离开房间的时候。你在身边时,我得保持警惕,知道吗?可不想怀孕,然后被十九双嫉妒的少年目光怒视。

lines.en: : Anyway, if you’re not grading anything right now, what are the notebooks for?
lines.zh: : 总之,如果你现在没有在改作业,这些笔记本是干什么用的?

lines.en: : These? A little independent studying.
lines.zh: : 这些?一点自主学习。

lines.en: : What’s the point of studying if you’re already a teacher?
lines.zh: : 都已经是老师了,学习的意义是什么?

lines.en: : Student teacher, technically. I’ve gotta put in a certain amount of work before I’m able to become a full-on teacher. They should be counting what I do for you as overtime, though.
lines.zh: : 严格来说是实习老师。我要完成规定的工作量,才能成为正式教师。不过,我替你干的这些,他们应该算我加班。

lines.en: : Yeah, I feel like I’ve all but taken the backseat at this point.
lines.zh: : 是啊,我感觉到了这一步,我基本已经坐上后排了。

lines.en: : Works for me. I get to do what I like to do and you get to do what you like to do.
lines.zh: : 正合我意。我干我喜欢干的事,你干你喜欢干的事。

lines.en: : Just maybe toss in a platonic massage every once in a while to keep me loose and ready to go.
lines.zh: : 只是偶尔加一次「无性按摩」,让我保持放松、随时待命就行。

lines.en: : Sure. How does right now sound?
lines.zh: : 好。现在如何?

lines.en: : Bad. I’m not done studying yet and we both know that any sort of massage in a room as small as this would end with one of us on top of the other.
lines.zh: : 不行。我还没学完,而且我们都清楚,在这么小的房间里做任何按摩,最后都会以一个人压在另一个人身上收场。

lines.en: : Oh no. Whatever would we do in a situation like that?
lines.zh: : 哦不。那种情况下我们该怎么办呢?

lines.en: : Back on track, Senpai. I will not allow you to seduce me while I’m already being ruthlessly penetrated by the intangible dick that is academia. And two dicks at once? Noooo thank you!
lines.zh: : 言归正传,Senpai。我绝不允许你在我已经被「学术」这根无形的肉棒无情贯穿时勾引我。同时来两根?谢————了,不必!

lines.en: : Must be some pretty intense studying if there’s an intangible penis inside of you right now.
lines.zh: : 你体内现在要是有一根无形的肉棒,那你的学习一定相当激烈。

lines.en: : It’s gotta be if I’m ever going to teach in college. Don’t want some punk who’s only a little younger than me getting snippy and acting like he knows more than I do.
lines.zh: : 不激烈不行,我还要去大学教书呢。我可不想某个只比我小几岁的小屁孩对我吆五喝六、装得比我懂。

lines.en: : Of course I say that now, still years away from any job like that...but still.
lines.zh: : 当然,我现在说这话,离那种工作还有好几年……但仍然。

lines.en: : You want to be a college professor?
lines.zh: : 你想当大学教授?

lines.en: : Mhm. Mainly for transfer students, I think. People who don’t natively speak Japanese and stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 嗯。主要面向转学生,我想。母语不是日语的人之类的。

lines.en: : What do they speak in Ghana?
lines.zh: : 加纳人说什么语言?

lines.en: : English.
lines.zh: : 英语。

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的?

lines.en: : What did you expect? German?
lines.zh: : 你以为呢?德语?

lines.en: : I’m not sure. I’ve just heard there were a bunch of languages in Africa and figured it would be something I hadn’t heard of before.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。我只是听说非洲有很多种语言,还以为是种我没听过的。

lines.en: : English is the official language, but I can speak Twi as well.
lines.zh: : 官方语言是英语,但我也会说特威语。

lines.en: : Which means there are three languages I’m fluent in. Which is nothing compared to the, like...ten that Touka’s mom can speak, but hey. Still pretty impressive.
lines.zh: : 也就是说,我能流利说的语言有三种。虽然和 Touka 妈妈那种……能说十种的比不算什么,但嘿。还是很了不起了。

lines.en: : Can you say something in Twi?
lines.zh: : 能用特威语说句什么吗?

lines.en: : Medɔ wo.
lines.zh: : Medɔ wo。

lines.en: : What does that mean?
lines.zh: : 那是什么意思?

lines.en: : It means learn the fucking language, Senpai.
lines.zh: : 意思是,他妈的去学这门语言,Senpai。

lines.en: : Is Twi a naturally rude dialect or are you just an asshole?
lines.zh: : 特威语天生就这么粗鲁,还是你就是个混球?

lines.en: : I’m just an asshole. But I’m your asshole, Senpai. At least until someone else is willing to hire me.
lines.zh: : 我就是个混球。但我是你的混球,Senpai。至少在别人愿意雇我之前是。

lines.en: : So if you were offered a college job, you’d leave right now?
lines.zh: : 那如果真有人给你一份大学的工作,你现在就会走?

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : Wow.
: What? You think I’d throw away my dreams just because I met you? Come on, you know me better than that.
lines.zh: : 什么?你以为我会因为遇见你就放弃梦想?拜托,你没那么不懂我。

lines.en: : You could have let me down a little softer, at least.
lines.zh: : 你至少可以委婉一点拒绝。

lines.en: : I’d keep in touch, obviously. It’s not like I’d just erase you from my mind the second I’m not your underling anymore.
lines.zh: : 我显然会保持联络。又不是说一不当你的下属,我就会把你从脑子里抹掉。

lines.en: : This is probably going to sound really depressing since this is the first time you’re coming over and we’ve only known each other for a little while, but...
lines.zh: : 这话大概听起来很丧——毕竟这是你第一次来我这,我们也认识没多久,但是……

lines.en: : You’re kind of my best friend.
lines.zh: : 你算得上我最好的朋友。

lines.en: : Really? Me? Not Wakana?
lines.zh: : 真的?我?不是 Wakana?

lines.en: : I like Wakana a lot.
lines.zh: : 我很喜欢 Wakana。

lines.en: : I just like you more.
lines.zh: : 只是我更喜欢你。

lines.en: : Plus, I get to see you for almost seven hours, five days out of every week.
lines.zh: : 加上,每周五天、每天将近七个小时,我都能见到你。

lines.en: : And you’re easier to talk to. And you wouldn’t abandon me at a table to go bang your girlfriend in the bathroom. Probably.
lines.zh: : 而且你更好聊。而且你不会把我丢在桌边、自己跑去洗手间和女朋友缠绵。大概。

lines.en: : Not going to lie, I probably would.
lines.zh: : 不撒谎,我多半会。

lines.en: : Okay, sure. But you’d probably invite me as well and it’s the thought that counts.
lines.zh: : 好吧,行。但你多半也会叫上我,心意到了就行。

lines.en: : Point is, it would take a lot more than just losing a best friend for me to start rethinking my future. Even if we were like, lovers or something...I’d still probably choose myself over you if it came down to it.
lines.zh: : 重点在于,要让我开始重新思考自己的未来,失去的恐怕得远不止一个最好的朋友。就算我们是,比如,恋人什么的……真到了那一步,我多半还是会选我自己,而不是你。

lines.en: : This is a goal I’ve had for myself since I was a kid, you know. It’s not something that’ll be so easily shaken.
lines.zh: : 你要知道,这是我从小到大给自己定下的目标。它不会轻易动摇。

lines.en: : What made you want to become a teacher?
lines.zh: : 你为什么想当老师?

lines.en: : Honestly...the money.
lines.zh: : 说实话……为了钱。

lines.en: : Rough.
: Yuuuuup. Mini-Imani figured that teachers, as important as they are, were paid handsomely and able to live on their own without any financial problems at all.
lines.zh: : 没错————。小小的 Imani 当时想,老师那么重要,薪水一定丰厚,一个人生活毫无经济压力。

lines.en: : Boy, do I wish I could travel back and time slap that little girl upside the head.
lines.zh: : 哎,真想穿越回去,扇那个小姑娘的后脑勺一巴掌。

lines.en: : Would’ve tried becoming a doctor or something if I knew I’d be living in a box at my age.
lines.zh: : 要是早知道到我这个年纪还会住在盒子里,我就去试着当医生什么的了。

lines.en: : It’s interesting that money’s what led you down this path in the first place. I feel like most people become teachers to, like...help children or something.
lines.zh: : 有意思,最初引领你走上这条路的居然是钱。我感觉大多数人当老师都是为了,那个……帮助小孩之类的。

lines.en: : I don’t even like kids. They’re loud...obnoxious...and always sticky for some reason.
lines.zh: : 我根本不喜欢小孩。他们吵……烦人……而且不知为何总是黏糊糊的。

lines.en: : Teenagers are fine because the stickiness kind of wears off after a while. But they’re still not ideal as looking at them reminds me that I’m getting older and getting older fucking suuuuucks.
lines.zh: : 青少年还好,那种黏糊劲儿过一阵就会褪掉。但他们也不理想——看着他们,只会提醒我我在变老,而变老他妈烦————死了。

lines.en: : Plus, being the youngest of seven, I never really had many chances to play with or talk to anybody younger than me. So I'm just not used to it.
lines.zh: : 再说,作为七个孩子里最小的那个,我从来没什么机会和比我小的人玩、和他们说话。所以我不习惯。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, seven?
lines.zh: : 抱歉,七个?

lines.en: : Three brothers, three sisters. All older. All in Ghana.
lines.zh: : 三个哥哥,三个姐姐。全都比我大。全在加纳。

lines.en: : Why aren’t any of them here with you?
lines.zh: : 为什么他们一个都不在你身边?

lines.en: : They can’t be.
lines.zh: : 他们不能。

lines.en: : What do you mean they can’t be?
lines.zh: : 「不能」是什么意思?

lines.en: : I mean I’m the only one with Japanese blood.
lines.zh: : 意思是,我是唯一有日本血统的。

lines.en: : You-
: They’re all technically half-siblings.
lines.zh: : 他们严格来说,都是我的同母异父兄妹。

lines.en: : I have a different biological father. But my actual father was a good man and insisted I was just as much his child as the rest of them- even knowing where I really came from.
lines.zh: : 我的生父另有其人。但我的养父是个好人,坚持认为我和其他孩子一样,都是他的骨肉——哪怕他清楚我真正的来处。

lines.en: : So I got to grow up in a house with a bunch of people I was only half-related to, still feeling like a bit of an outcast even though I was welcome there.
lines.zh: : 所以我是在一屋子只有一半血缘的人中间长大的,即使他们欢迎我,我仍始终感觉自己是个局外人。

lines.en: : Having seven kids is hard to afford, though...so we scraped by, but never had much money.
lines.zh: : 养七个孩子开销很大……所以我们勉强度日,从来没什么钱。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I thought that maybe striking it rich one day would help me buy my rightful place in the family. But somewhere along the way, I started actually liking the idea of teaching.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。我曾以为,有朝一日发财致富,就能为我买回我在家里应有的位置。但不知从哪一步起,我开始真心喜欢上了教书这个念头。

lines.en: : No one else in my family has ever made it to college, so the fact that I have is just-
lines.zh: : 我家从来没有人上过大学,所以我能坐在教室里这件事本身,就已经——

lines.en: : Oh, crap. I’m like, hardcore unloading on you right now, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 哦,糟。我现在像是在 hardcore 向你倾倒垃圾情绪,对吧?

lines.en: : It’s fine. I had no idea about literally...any of that.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我几乎一件都不知道。

lines.en: : The condensed version is that I’m always going to feel out of place and that I want to prove to both my family and myself that I belong. The end. Imani backstory complete.
lines.zh: : 简而言之:我永远会有格格不入之感,而我想向家人、也向自己证明,我有归属。完。Imani 背景故事播放完毕。

lines.en: : I’m sure there’s a lot more to you than just that, Imani.
lines.zh: : 我确信关于你,远不止这些,Imani。

lines.en: : Of course there is. But there’s no reason I should be unpacking my entire childhood right now when I’ve yet to even unpack my boxes.
lines.zh: : 当然不止。但我连自己的行李箱都还没拆,没有理由在此刻把整个童年都拆给你看。

lines.en: : You’ll learn more as time goes by...naturally. Without it coming in the form of some spontaneous info-dump only partially relating to a question you asked.
lines.zh: : 随着时间推移,你会了解更多……自然地。而不是以一场自发的信息倾倒的形式——还只回答了你问题的一部分。

lines.en: : There are over seven billion people on this planet and somehow, we were lucky enough to wind up with each other.
lines.zh: : 这颗星球上有七十多亿人,而我们不知怎的,幸运地落在了彼此身边。

lines.en: : That should be enough for now.
lines.zh: : 目前而言,这就够了。

lines.en: : Let’s just enjoy the fact that we-
lines.zh: : 不如就享受我们——

lines.en: : You know you’re blushing, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道你在脸红,对吧?

lines.en: : I’m what? No, I-
lines.zh: : 我怎么了?不,我没有——

lines.en: : Shit.
: You’re right.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。

lines.en: : Mind looking away for a minute or two while I repeatedly remind myself that we’re just friends and that anything more than that could jeopardize the first real relationship I’ve ever had in this country?
lines.zh: : 介意回避一两分钟吗?让我反复提醒自己,我们只是朋友——再多一点,都可能危及我来这个国家后拥有的第一段真实关系。

lines.en: : I think you might be unloading again.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你又在倾倒垃圾情绪了。

lines.en: : You know, I knew this was gonna happen too. I’m going over to your place next time.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,我也早料到会这样。下次去你家。

lines.en: : You think you’ll be any safer there?
lines.zh: : 你觉得在那就安全了?

lines.en: : Than in an oversized shoebox where our knees have been touching this entire time? Probably.
lines.zh: : 比起在一个超大号鞋盒里、膝盖都贴了一整晚的地方?大概。

lines.en: : Didn’t realize your knees were your weak spot.
lines.zh: : 没想到你的膝盖是你的弱点。

lines.en: : Probs because I figured it was something you didn’t kneed to know.
lines.zh: : 大概因为我以为那是你不必「知膝」了解的事。

lines.en: : Okay, I’m leaving.
lines.zh: : 好,我走了。

lines.en: : Hey, you don’t have to completely bail! I just want my face to go back to its normal, beautiful color! The color that doesn’t make it look like I want to bang my boss!
lines.zh: : 嘿,你不用直接跑路!我只想让我的脸恢复成正常的、美丽的颜色!那种看起来不像「想上我老板」的颜色!

lines.en: Imani settles down and prevents me from leaving.
lines.zh: Imani 定下神来,拦下了我。

lines.en: Thankfully (For her, at least. I still don’t really care), she figures out how to restrain herself from exposing any additional info and the rest of the night passes by filled with our typical, mindless banter.
lines.zh: 所幸(至少对她而言。我还是无所谓),她克制住了自己,没有再暴露更多信息。剩下的夜晚,在我们一贯的、不过脑子的斗嘴中溜走。

lines.en: I learned a lot about her tonight- intentional or not...but there’s still plenty I don’t understand yet.
lines.zh: 今晚我了解了她很多——有意或无意……但还有太多我不明白的。

lines.en: And I can’t help but wonder if I'll be able to fill in the blanks before she inevitably leaves me.
lines.zh: 而我忍不住想,在她终将离我而去之前,我能否把这些空白填满。

lines.en: Imani’s affection has increased to [imani_love]!
lines.zh: Imani 的好感度提升到了 [imani_love]!
